purpose: Qualify the pure-information lookahead mechanism and decision-relevant statistic; reject a manufactured superiority claim over the identical classical baseline.
terminal_reward: Exactly 1{answer=H}; no reward for readiness, queries or internal state.

family.probe_accuracy_when_ready: p in [1/2,1], symmetric binary channel with known orientation
family.durations: Known positive deterministic integer durations; actual consumed duration enters price and deadline.
family.cancellation: Fee paid at launch; timeout at cap leaves state unchanged and reveals no future label or state.

method_inputs: Known contract plus purchased complete-chain (S,S*B) observations only; no evaluator law or deployment hidden label.
mandatory_comparators: Known-law receding one-step VOI, explicitly diagnostic
Known-law full-history two-query DP, explicitly diagnostic
Same-data same-structure maximum-likelihood model plus exact DP, with the same confidence/stopping/accounting contract

stochastic_superiority_confirmation.reason: The direct statistic and same-structure MLE plus DP execute the same policy on every observed count path. Under identical sampling/checkpoints/accounting there is no algorithmic gain to confirm.

deterministic_qualification.complete_count_triples: All 0<=b<=s<=n for n=1,...,16; these are algebraic fixtures, not collected observations.
deterministic_qualification.confidence_fixtures: Explicit constructed counts only; no observed statistical coverage claim.
deterministic_qualification.source_binding: The receipt binds mechanism.py, verify_mechanism.py and this protocol.

prior_experiment: The original 144-cell source freeze, primary endpoint, data and NO_GO decision remain unchanged.
